description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for logging purposes, providing static methods for different log levels and managing LogNode chaining. It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, enabling custom log node implementations.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static logging methods and log node management, acting as a wrapper around Android's native Log.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches log data to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
